scope: Public static audit of S1–S5 boundaries and integration requirements only.
author: external-audit-orchestrator

reserved_oracles.replacement: Public verification criteria frozen independently by the orchestrator; no private answers reconstructed.

common.requirement: Pin code and tree to source_revision; pin protocol and S1–S5 prompts separately. No moving-head code inference.
Every cited source has repository path, revision, Git object SHA observed from MCP (or UNKNOWN) and actual read scope. Tree metadata is not content evidence.
Claims distinguish source observation, normative intent, static inference, hypothesis and UNKNOWN. Static evidence never establishes runtime execution or success.
All remote writes are orchestrator-only under the authorized output prefix on the explicit baseline-derived branch; leases and force:false protect publication.
No product/protocol/workflow modifications; no tests, CI dispatch, Atlas/native product tools, consumers, merges, deployment, private-state reconstruction or other-session result reads.
No reserved oracle, full private review, ledger, capture, secret or local filesystem path is published. Public findings may identify the affected public artifact and correction.
Hashes are source-provided or deterministically calculated over specified bytes. Unobservable identities/measurements remain UNKNOWN; absent evidence is not zero.

Three disjoint producers A/B/C create the candidate; separate fresh reviewer identities with fork_turns:none evaluate all applicable frozen criteria against the same exact package. Authors never judge their own work.
Material findings are corrected and reevaluated by the same reviewers or remain explicitly open. No third vote or replacement to bypass a veto.

Final publication binds a prior payload commit, confirms branch SHA and preserves a recovery path. Result remains a static candidate for coordination, never global PASS, integration completion or owner acceptance.

inventory.requirement: Verify baseline commit→root tree through MCP.
Enumerate all descendants with complete non-truncated tree responses; document decomposition and failures without treating transport failure as Git truncation.
Report tree/blob/commit types, modes, symlinks, gitlinks and counts separately.
Reconcile tracked leaf population with 14442; directories are separately visible; report any difference and verified cause or UNKNOWN.
Apply exact_file > longest_directory_prefix > fallback with slash boundaries; compare S1–S5 counts, top-level counts and fallback counts.
Report duplicate paths, competing rule matches, unresolved ownership, missing exact rules, empty prefixes and all exclusions.
Recompute both global and shard digests using exact UTF-8 byte sorting and LF record encoding, or mark unavailable calculations UNKNOWN.
Persist complete enumerated metadata with deterministic ordering and sufficient object identity for independent reconstruction.
Use source references actually read, distinguishing enumerated blob metadata from content inspection.
Inventory reconciliation does not assert semantic coverage, extraction of reserved Omni/Platform slices, runtime support or acceptance.

contracts.requirement: Each evidence source records path, pin, Git blob SHA and complete/partial read scope.
Assign node owners with the partition resolver, not labels alone.
Separate navigation, build and impact relations; state direction and mechanism for each edge.
Investigate CLI→core/API, seat→Maestro/Relay and client→API/knowledge; retain UNKNOWN when evidence cannot close a chain.
Imports/declarations do not prove execution; impact is a bounded static inference unless stronger observed evidence exists.
Each edge cites decisive source and destination evidence actually read, with claim scope matching available excerpts.
Do not promote hypotheses/gaps into verified edges or add unsupported edges to complete a visual graph.
Expose limitations and remaining integration controls without running or claiming them.

criteria.requirement: Preserve exactly the 50 registry IDs and their sequence; no omission, duplicate or renumbering.
Preserve each referenced normative source line literally; keep mapping and explanatory interpretation separate.
Each criterion identifies local owners, S4 common responsibilities and ROOT/global complement with references; distinguish normative assignment from derived planning allocation.
Decisive evidence is an explicit future evidence requirement, never an invented observed result.
Describe reusable evidence and compatibility conditions for exact candidate, contract, inputs and scope; unknown available evidence remains UNKNOWN.
Every ID has pending gates/dependencies or justified static disposition; lack of proof is not NOT_APPLICABLE.
The minimal integration control plan is NOT_RUN, includes dependencies and avoids repeated common S4 work without suppressing domain-specific cases.
The source manifest lists only actual reads, including the normative source at its exact baseline blob.
No private oracle, complete private review, ledger, secret, local path, acceptance or runtime verdict is published.

review_protocol.scope: Independent static candidate review only; not the coordination integration pair.
review_protocol.delivery: Exact public artifact bodies and decisive source excerpts; public findings summary only.
